item.title: BitBasel Presents The King’s Exhibition with Dr. Glenn Toby at Sagamore South Beach
item.description: Miami, FL - December 7, 2025 - BitBasel’s 6th Annual Miami Art Week fair, themed “Fingerprints of Humanity,” took place from December 3–7, 2025, at The Sagamore Hotel South Beach. The event united art, technology, and culture in a weeklong program of headline exhibitions, summits, and late-night celebrations. Amongst those joining the inaugural party were SOFI TUKKER, QuavoHuncho, Corey Gamble, Afrojack, and Surf Lodge founder Jayma Cardoso amongst many more.
